subject.title: Reject split outbound agent session ownership

question: Should Gateway send support separately owned requester and transcript-mirror session fields as a durable public contract, or should this PR stay limited to validating the existing agentId/sessionKey ownership model?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes a previously accepted request shape to fail closed and, according to the prior review, adds Gateway fields for pairwise ownership; source-level correctness cannot choose that public compatibility direction without owner intent.

options.title: Approve the pairwise Gateway contract
options.body: Keep requester/mirror ownership fields, document their upgrade semantics, and require exact-head proof for mismatch rejection and allowed cross-policy routing.

options.title: Narrow to existing ownership inputs
options.body: Retain the shared guard for the established agentId/sessionKey paths and remove or defer new pairwise Gateway API surface until separately sponsored.

recommendation.title: Narrow to existing ownership inputs
recommendation.body: Retain the shared guard for the established agentId/sessionKey paths and remove or defer new pairwise Gateway API surface until separately sponsored.
